hero.title: Empowering Minds, Inspiring Character, Shaping Futures
hero.subtitle: Fisenge Secondary School delivers holistic secondary education rooted in academic rigor, modern science facilities, cultural enrichment, and discipline on the Copperbelt.

about.overview: Fisenge Secondary School is a premier government-aided secondary institution situated along the Copperbelt corridor in Luanshya District, Zambia. We provide comprehensive secondary education from Grade 8 through Grade 12 under the Examinations Council of Zambia (ECZ) syllabus.
about.mission: To provide high-quality, inclusive, and transformative secondary education that empowers every learner with intellectual competence, moral fortitude, technological awareness, and practical skills for nation-building.
about.vision: To be a center of excellence in secondary education on the Copperbelt, recognized for producing disciplined, inventive, and community-minded citizens capable of thriving globally.

values.title: Academic Rigor
values.description: Cultivating critical thinking, inquiry, and consistent dedication to scholastic excellence.

values.title: Integrity & Respect
values.description: Upholding honesty, mutual respect, accountability, and ethical behavior in all spheres of life.

values.title: Inclusivity & Community
values.description: Welcoming diverse talents, supporting vulnerable learners, and serving the wider Fisenge community.

values.title: Environmental Stewardship
values.description: Instilling responsibility for green campus initiatives, agricultural education, and resource care.

about.principalMessage: Welcome to Fisenge Secondary School. Our commitment is simple yet profound: ensuring every young person who walks through our gates receives not only top-tier academic training in sciences, humanities, and commerce, but also the character mentorship required to lead with honour in Zambia and beyond. We invite families to partner with us in nurturing the next generation of pioneers.
about.campusDescription: Our peaceful, sprawling campus features dedicated science laboratories, a stocked reference library, computer lab, multipurpose assembly hall, sports fields, and agricultural project units that foster experiential learning.

students.overview: At Fisenge Secondary School, student life blends strong academic foundations with vibrant extracurricular programs, leadership bodies, and sports.
students.curriculumSummary: We follow the Examinations Council of Zambia (ECZ) national curriculum across Junior Secondary (Grades 8–9) and Senior Secondary (Grades 10–12).

academicStreams.title: Pure & Applied Sciences Stream
academicStreams.description: Designed for aspiring engineers, doctors, technologists, and agricultural scientists with hands-on lab experiments.

academicStreams.title: Business & Commercial Studies Stream
academicStreams.description: Equipping future accountants, entrepreneurs, financial analysts, and corporate leaders with foundational acumen.

academicStreams.title: Arts & Humanities Stream
academicStreams.description: Fostering deep analytical inquiry, legal foundations, diplomacy, social science insight, and eloquent communication.

academicStreams.title: Practical & Vocational Skills
academicStreams.description: Hands-on practical training fostering entrepreneurship and technical craftsmanship.

rules.title: Attendance & Punctuality
points: School begins at 07:30 prompt every weekday. Gates close at 07:45 for morning assembly.
Minimum 90% attendance is mandatory to be registered for terminal and national examinations.
All absences must be substantiated with a written parent or medical letter.

rules.title: Uniform and Grooming Standards
points: Prescribed school uniform (navy blazer, pristine sky blue shirt, charcoal trousers/pleated skirts, and black polished leather shoes) is required every school day.
Sports attire is permitted exclusively on scheduled physical education and club afternoons.
Neat hair grooming without artificial embellishments in accordance with Ministry of Education regulations.

rules.title: Conduct & Electronic Devices
points: Bullying, substance possession, and vandalism carry zero tolerance and immediate disciplinary review.
Mobile phones and non-approved electronic devices must be surrendered at the security office during learning hours.
Respect for teachers, prefects, school property, and fellow learners is an absolute expectation.

parents.welcome: Parents and guardians are essential partners in our educational mission. We maintain transparent communication and close collaboration through our active Parent-Teacher Association (PTA).

guidelines.title: Parent-Teacher Consultations
guidelines.description: Scheduled at mid-term and end of each term. Parents receive one-on-one progress reviews with subject teachers and class mentors.

guidelines.title: School Fees & Payment Policy
guidelines.description: All government-stipulated PTA levies and boarding/project contributions must be deposited directly into the designated school bank account. Cash payments at school gates are strictly prohibited.

guidelines.title: Visiting Guidelines
guidelines.description: Parents visiting for enquiries must sign in at the security gate and report directly to the Administration Office. Classrooms may not be disrupted during instruction hours.

guidelines.title: Health & Wellbeing Updates
guidelines.description: Please update the school clinic nurse promptly regarding any pre-existing health conditions, allergies, or emergency contact modifications.

announcements.title: Term 1 Mid-Term Assessments and Parent Consultations Schedule
announcements.summary: Mid-term examinations will commence next Monday. All parents are invited to the consultation session on Friday.
announcements.content: Grade 8 through Grade 12 learners will write continuous assessment tests from Monday to Thursday. Friday has been reserved for full-day Parent-Teacher consultations. Reports and progress tracking will be reviewed.

announcements.title: Grade 8 & 10 Admissions: Second Intake Verification Deadline
announcements.summary: Families with acceptance letters must finalize registration dossiers at the Bursar office before Friday 4:00 PM.
announcements.content: Please present original primary school leaving certificates, two passport photos, and medical clearance certificates at the admissions desk in the main hall.

announcements.title: Annual Provincial JETS Science Fair Registrations Open
announcements.summary: Students interested in entering science, renewable energy, and ICT projects are encouraged to submit project outlines.
announcements.content: The JETS club mentors will host project development clinics every Wednesday afternoon. Prizes and regional qualification opportunities await winners.

announcements.title: Copperbelt Inter-Secondary Athletics Meet
announcements.summary: Fisenge track and field athletes qualify for four sprint and long-distance finals this coming weekend.
announcements.content: We congratulate our relay team and 800m runners for qualifying for the regional championships. School spirit supporters are welcome.
